rule: A company counts as headquartered in the United States when it is actually run from there. The Wikipedia constituents table (headquarters_location) is the default. For companies it lists outside the US, the company's own latest annual report decides: if the report names a US location as its main operational, administrative, corporate or (co-)principal executive office, it counts as US. If the report names a foreign headquarters and only a regional US office (e.g. 'North American headquarters'), it does not. When the report says neither, a US business or mailing address on the company's SEC registration is used.

MDT.evidence: FY2026 10-K, Properties: principal executive office in Ireland; 'main operational offices are located in the Minneapolis, Minnesota metropolitan area'.

STE.evidence: FY2026 10-K: principal executive office in Dublin, Ireland; 'primary administrative offices are located in Mentor, OH'.

LIN.evidence: 2025 10-K, Properties: principal executive offices in Woking, United Kingdom and Danbury, Connecticut.

EG.evidence: 2025 10-K, Properties: corporate offices in Warren, New Jersey; SEC mailing address Warren, NJ.

LYB.evidence: SEC business address Houston, TX; 2025 10-K lists executive offices in London, Rotterdam, Houston and Hong Kong.

PNR.evidence: SEC mailing address Golden Valley, MN; annual report names no other operating headquarters.

TT.evidence: SEC mailing address Davidson, NC; annual report names no other operating headquarters.

ALLE.evidence: SEC mailing address Carmel, IN; annual report names no other operating headquarters.
